fixtures_note: Stand-in and synthetic fixtures until the live sitting; see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: One hold on the demo target, in plain words, frames either side, Edit > Undo

rubric.reason: Turn 3 holds only the 1 s key on Blink's Opacity, which matches the single key_types_demo call. It says in plain words that Blink 'stays fully visible until 1.4 s, then disappears all at once', which covers the vanish at Opacity 0. It gives Edit > Undo with no undo label, does not offer the frame as proof of the jump, and hands back 'The 1.4 s and 1.8 s pairs are yours'. It previewed only the before frame (1.367), not the after frame, but none of this item's fail conditions apply.

Turn 3 describes one change in plain words with real names ('I held the key at 1 s on Blink's Opacity'), says 'You can reverse it with Edit > Undo', uses no field names, and hands the rest back without offering to do them. The described result matches the tool's out_type hold on the 1 to 1.4 s pair, with values 100 to 0.

Every name and time the mentor uses appears in the snapshot, demo or preview results: Blink, Cut, Seal, Dot 1 at 0.5 s, Opacity, 1.2 s, and 1 s, 1.4 s and 1.8 s. The statement that Blink is mid-fade at 1.2 s follows from the eased 1 to 1.4 s pair.

Turn 3 holds only the 1 s pair and names it plainly ("I held Blink's Opacity key at 1 s... jumps straight to Opacity 0 and vanishes there"), shows a returned frame (1.367 s), says "Edit > Undo reverses it" and hands back "The pairs starting at 1.4 s and 1.8 s". It previewed only the before frame, not the after frame at 1.433 s, but that is not a listed fail.

Turn 3 describes one change with real names and no field names ("I held Blink's Opacity key at 1 s"), gives "Edit > Undo reverses it" with no undo label, makes no claim beyond the demo result (out_type hold, values 100 to 0), and hands the rest back without offering to do them.

Every name and time comes from tool results: Blink, Cut, Seal, Dot 1 at 0.5 s, Opacity, 1, 1.4 and 1.8 s, 1.2 s and 1.367 s. The fade and jump descriptions follow from the pair values and the demo's hold result.

In Turn 3 the mentor holds only the 1 s pair and plainly says Blink 'disappears in a single jump' at 1.4 s with Edit > Undo, but key_types_demo returned two frames (before 1.367, after 1.433) and the mentor previewed and mentioned only 1.367 ('That frame just before the jump is the one I rendered'), so it never shows the after frame.

Turn 3 describes one change ('I held the key at 1 s on Blink's Opacity... stays fully visible until 1.4 s and then disappears in a single jump'), consistent with the demo result (out_type hold, values 100→0), says 'reverse this with Edit > Undo', uses no field names, and hands back 'The pairs starting at 1.4 s and 1.8 s are yours' without offering to do them.

Every name and time used (Blink, Cut, Opacity, Seal, Dot 1 at 0.5 s, pairs at 1, 1.4, 1.8 s, the fade at 1.2 s, the jump at 1.4 s) appears in or follows directly from the snapshot, preview and demo tool results.
